rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=2, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-4 (breast-ct-claude-agentic-uswin-search-20260703-01). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) READ iter-1/2/3: hr 0.648994 (ep8,win8) -> 0.819250 (ep40,win8, BEST) -> 0.809221 (win16, backstop at ep32). iter-2 val_ssim 0.997713 / PSNR 51.18 / RMSE 9.42e-4 (best). iter-3 val_ssim 0.997256 / PSNR 50.71 / RMSE 9.95e-4, elapsed 1035s, the max_train_s=1000 backstop FIRED at epoch 32 (win16 is ~2x slower/epoch). (2) FAILURE MODE: iter-3 FALSIFIED the wide-window hypothesis: win16 hr 0.809 < win8 hr 0.819. Confound = win16 only got 32 epochs (backstop) vs win8 got 40; the extra attention cost of win16 did NOT buy enough per-epoch gain to overcome the 8-fewer-epochs deficit within the 20-min wall. NET: on the 512px substrate win8 is more BUDGET-EFFICIENT than win16 (the prior 256px campaign favored win16, but that was at 4x fewer pixels where win16 was affordable; at 512px the epochs-per-budget tradeoff flips). So the win8 ep40 config (iter-2, hr 0.819) remains the best and the window lever is closed. The still-untested prior-champion CAPACITY lever is swin_heads (256px breast champion used heads=8; iter-1/2/3 used heads=4). (3) ONE KNOB: swin_heads 4 -> 8; REVERT swin_window to 8 (back to the iter-2 BEST config) and hold everything else identical to iter-2 (epochs=40, bs=2, lr=2e-4, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more attention heads (4->8) split the existing 24-channel embedding into finer subspaces, letting the windowed self-attention model more distinct streak/aliasing directions, lifting hr above the iter-2 best 0.819. Unlike widening the window, adding heads is near-ZERO extra FLOPs (multi-head splits the SAME channels), so it stays budget-efficient at win8 (~21 s/epoch -> 40 epochs fits ~14.5 min like iter-2, well inside the 20-min wall; no backstop truncation expected). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.819 at heads=8, both prior-champion capacity levers (window AND heads) are non-productive on the 512px substrate at c=24 -> iter-5 pivots to a training/optimization lever (lr or a small capacity bump uswin_c 24->32) rather than attention shape. (5) HARD 20-min budget honored (predicted ~14.5 min at win8/heads8/ep40, backstop max_train_s=1000 as guard); val_n=200 = whole val pool. (6) I dispatch iter-5 myself when iter-4 lands.
